snippet.title: Space Reign — 1.0 Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
After nearly three years of development, Space Reign is leaving Early Access and launching into its full 1.0 release.

Since the start of Early Access, the game has grown significantly through updates, system improvements, and community feedback. Fleet mechanics have been refined, new modes introduced, balance adjusted, and core systems expanded to deliver a more complete tactical and strategic experience. With the 1.0 launch, we have fulfilled our original Early Access commitment and completed the full development roadmap outlined at the beginning of the project.

Steam link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1762570/Space_Reign/

Become our patreon and support us on our journey! https://www.patreon.com/propulsivegames

Space Reign is a part space sim, part strategy indie game about fleet combat, management, and completing security contracts for resource exploiting corporations in the near future, which are in a state of constant conflict over territory control.

Version 1.0 represents the most stable and feature-complete version of the game so far.

Check out our discord channel for even more frequent updates ! https://discord.gg/VWeyz74

Music from Artlistio
